When I came back to [dfolio(at)free](/) (after 10 years), I learn that
[free.fr](http://pagesperso.free.fr/) hosting service does not (really) allows
flat-system database, and thus [PmWiki](http://www.pmwiki.org) :/ That is why I
have looked for a new website management system (but I still dislike SQL
databases). Finally, I have discovered [Jekyll](https://jekyllrb.com) that is
for *static* website, from plain-text (aka markdown based). This has lead to a
totaly new [dfolio(at)free](/)  website. For now the previous
[dfolio(at)free](/) contents have been removed. But maybe, latter, I'd put back
some of the previous contents. Come here again to see the evolution.
